*   **Time Complexity:** The precomputation step is reduced from $O(J \times G^3)$ to $O(J)$ by leveraging translation covariance and computing only canonical kernels [S1, unofficial].

The evidence explicitly states that a naïve implementation incurs cubic computational complexity ($J × G^3$) and that 'the translation covariance of wavelet bases allows us to compute only the canonical kernel... for each level'. This implies that by leveraging translation covariance and computing only canonical kernels, the precomputation complexity is reduced from $O(J × G^3)$ to $O(J)$ (one computation per level J).
